subject.title: docs(install): add vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide

question: Should OpenClaw first-party docs accept a vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide, and should the page omit turnkey third-party hardware references entirely?
rationale: The patch is docs-only and useful, but related discussion and VISION.md leave a real boundary decision between first-party hardware install guidance and ecosystem/vendor promotion.

options.title: Accept Vendor-Neutral Guide After Repair
options.body: Land a source-backed Jetson install guide after the NVIDIA setup instructions are corrected and turnkey product references stay out of core docs.

options.title: Route Jetson Hardware Docs Outside Core
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep Jetson-specific hardware guidance in vendor, community, or ClawHub surfaces unless maintainers sponsor it later.

options.title: Allow A Neutral Turnkey Reference
options.body: Permit a tightly scoped turnkey-options note, accepting the ongoing support and promotion-boundary review cost in first-party docs.

recommendation.title: Accept Vendor-Neutral Guide After Repair
recommendation.body: Land a source-backed Jetson install guide after the NVIDIA setup instructions are corrected and turnkey product references stay out of core docs.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is closest to the documented ClawHub/vendor-promotion policy trail and previous related scope decision.
